title: Iterative Neural Variational Solver of Committor Function in Under-damped Langevin Dynamics
abstract: arXiv:2610.20617v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The committor function describes the probability that a stochastic dynamical system, while transitioning between two metastable states, will first reach one state rather than the other. It is a central object in transition path theory, providing the accurate reaction rate and the characterization of the transition mechanism through reactive probability flux and the transition state ensemble. While the numerical methods for this function are well studied for over-damped Langevin dynamics where the friction damping coefficient goes to infinity, its computation in the general under-damped case remains an open challenge due to the lack of a variational structure in the underlying backward Kolmogorov equation. This restricts the quantitative investigation of the impact of the finite damping coefficient on rare transitions in real systems. translated_title: 欠阻尼朗之万动力学中承诺函数的迭代神经变分求解器
translated_abstract: 承诺函数描述了随机动力学系统在两个亚稳态之间转变时，首先到达其中一个状态而非另一个状态的概率。它是转变路径理论中的核心对象，通过反应性概率流和过渡态系综提供了精确的反应速率以及对转变机制的特征刻画。尽管针对摩擦阻尼系数趋于无穷大的过阻尼朗之万动力学，该函数的数值方法已得到充分研究，但由于其背后的后向Kolmogorov方程缺乏变分结构，在一般欠阻尼情形下计算该函数仍然是一个悬而未决的挑战。这限制了对实际系统中有限阻尼系数对稀有转变影响的定量研究。在这项工作中，通过将欠阻尼朗之万动力学的无穷小生成元分解……
tldr: 本文提出了一种计算欠阻尼朗之万动力学中承诺函数的迭代神经变分求解器，克服了后向Kolmogorov方程缺乏变分结构这一长期挑战，从而能够定量研究有限阻尼系数对系统中稀有转变的影响。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an iterative neural variational solver for computing the committor function in under-damped Langevin dynamics, overcoming the long-standing challenge posed by the lack of variational structure in the backward Kolmogorov equation, enabling quantitative investigation of the impact of finite damping coefficients on rare transitions in real systems.
